item.title: Flutterwave now owns the infrastructure its rivals depend on
item.description: Flutterwave has acquired Mono, but at the same time, it now owns an infrastructure most of it rivals depend on, here's what it means.

item.title: Techpoint Africa Joins As Media Partner for Tech Revolution 2.0 Conference: Elevating Africa’s Innovative Narrative
item.description: Tech Revolution Africa 2.0, under the theme "The Big Bold Step," is set to be the premier convergence point for Africa's tech leaders.

item.title: inDrive drivers cry out over double VAT deductions
item.description: In today's Techpoint Digest, we discuss how inDrive drivers are outraged by double VAT deductions, how Zambia is going digital with passport applications, and how OpenAI beats Google in the health chatbot race.

item.title: Tunde Ebohon on building Wrkman, leadership, and creating structure for Nigeria’s informal economy
item.description: In Nigeria, finding a good plumber or technician often depends on who you know and some luck. Tunde Ebohon set out to change that. With years of business experience, he built Wrkman to bring trust, structure, and opportunity to the informal service economy.

item.title: Failed airtime and data purchases in Nigeria will be refunded in 30 seconds under proposed NCC, CBN rules
item.description: Nigerians may soon get refunds for failed airtime and data purchases in as little as 30 seconds. A new NCC, CBN framework sets clearer rules for banks and telcos and promises faster resolution of failed transactions.

item.title: How an accidental VR encounter shaped the career trajectory of this emerging technologies specialist from PwC to MTN
item.description: In this edition of After Hours, Babatunde Fatai shares how discovering virtual reality while studying mechanical engineering led to an early job offer at PwC and leading emerging tech at MTN.

item.title: Nigerian court dismisses ₦1 billion suit against MTN
item.description: In today's Techpoint Digest, we discuss the court dismissal of the ₦1 billion lawsuit against MTN, turning curiosity into a career in tech, and Nigeria cracking down on delayed airtime refunds.

item.title: Terra re-enters Africa’s defence market as it raises $11.75 million
item.description: Terra Industries, a Nigerian defence startup run by 22-year-old Nathan Nwachuku, has raised $11.75 million, with Palantir co-founder Joe Lonsdale’s 8VC leading the round.

item.title: 20 African startups to watch in 2026
item.description: From logistics and fintech to AI and climate tech, these African startups are tackling real problems and shaping the continent’s next wave of innovation.

item.title: Elon Musk’s Starlink continues to face issues in South Africa. Here’s what has happened so far
item.description: Starlink has expanded rapidly across Africa, but in South Africa, the service remains unavailable, held back by licensing requirements, ownership rules, and a growing regulatory standoff. Here’s how the dispute has unfolded.
